tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided siphon base and signed square-root branch numerically, allowing the full fallback range for rho. Fresh confirmation will test whether the fitted law generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows already identify the three-parameter guided branch and span a substantial gradient range; confirmation should be attempted first.
The verified siphon subtree and monotone-concave branch guidance provide a more specific mechanism consistent with the pilot signatures.
The guided readout is a static reduced law, so an additional trajectory is not needed to identify its parameters.
